title: Permission tool nouns reach the cc-watch evidence gate
description: Issue 2997: the cc-release-watch evidence gate dropped plain tool nouns like Bash, so permission features without backticks were stamped triaged-noop-no-evidence while src/settings/ held 34 Bash( rules. A class-T token now greps only src/settings/ and src/hooks/hooks.json for the Noun( rule form.
